symptom: `alter page … set (Action: …) on card1` on a clickable container refused: widget "card1" (Forms$DivContainer) has no Action property — while the message itself named a clickable container as a valid target; the same refusal hit a list view or image with an on-click action
cause: SetWidgetAction looked only for the key "Action" (a button's). Built-in widgets name their one click action per type: Forms$DivContainer.OnClickAction, Forms$ListView / Forms$StaticImageViewer / Forms$ImageViewer .ClickAction. CREATE and describe already used the right keys
insight: The key comes from the stored document, not a type table: every one of these is a required part, so presence decides and a widget is never given a key its type lacks (Studio Pro throws on an unknown property while mxbuild tolerates it — the reason the refusal exists). The old guard test pinned a DivContainer with NO OnClickAction as the refusal case — a shape Mendix never stores, which is how the gap looked deliberate; refusal fixtures need a type that really lacks the property (DynamicText). `OnClick:` on a built-in stays refused with a pointer to `set (Action:)` (TestSetWidgetNamedAction_RefusesBuiltInWidget), which is now a pointer that works. Two unrelated defects met on the way: a static image is CE0582 in a React-client app, and the reference check accepts `Atlas_Core.Content.mendix` for the stored `Mendix` (its hint prints the name lowercased) while mx reports CE1613
